description: A two-tone diaphone's blast: a high tone then a lower one held to the blast's end, as Port Royal's great signal sounds ('two tones, the second lower', IHO S-12; a two-tone diaphone sustains its lower tone). Each is a buzzing tone of strong harmonics through a low-pass that opens as the blast swells (Risset and Mathews 1969); the high tone sounds for high of the blast. harmonics are the partials' levels. A point source: its level falls 6 dB each time the distance doubles from near metres. Frequencies in Hz, times in seconds, levels as gains.
